textos.texto: Ana has a lot of free time on the weekend and she has many hobbies. She loves music: she listens to music every day and she plays the guitar in her bedroom. She does not sing very well, but she likes to sing with her friends. On Monday and Wednesday she goes to the gym near the park: there she does running for thirty minutes. She hates football, but she likes tennis: on Saturday she plays tennis with Laura. Laura is in a basketball team and she plays with a big ball every Friday. Ana does not swim in winter, because the water is very cold, but in summer swimming is her sport. On Sunday morning she paints and she draws in the garden: it is fun and it is not expensive. In the evening Ana watches a film with Paul. They love films, but they hate long films. Sometimes they play chess: it is a slow game, but it is fun.

textos.texto: Paul plays football in a small team with his friends. They play every Saturday in the stadium near the school. Paul loves this sport: he runs a lot and he is with his friends. His team is not very good, but the games are fun. Lee plays too: he takes the ball and he runs very fast. After the game they eat in a café near the stadium and they listen to music. Paul hates basketball, because he is not tall, and he does not like tennis. In winter the team does not play football: the road is not good, so they go to the gym. There Paul does running and Lee plays chess with the doctor of the team. Paul does not swim: he hates swimming and cold water. On Sunday he watches a game on the computer with his father. His mother plays the guitar and she sings: she loves music, but she does not like sport. In his free time Paul draws his team.

textos.texto: Every Saturday Laura goes to a music party in the house of a friend. She loves songs in English and she listens to music all the day. Laura plays the guitar very well and she sings: her friends love her songs. Ana does not sing, but she likes to dance. In the party there is music, food and games: sometimes they play chess, sometimes a game with a ball in the garden. It is very fun. Paul does not dance: he hates parties with many friends, so he watches a film in his house. Lee plays the guitar too, but he does not sing. In her free time Laura also paints and draws: she draws her friends in the party. She wants to travel to England for the music. Ana prefers sport: she plays tennis and she does swimming in summer. The two friends are not the same, but on Saturday they are always in the same house.

textos.texto: Marie has many hobbies in her free time. She loves music: she listens to songs in English every day and she plays the guitar. She does not sing well, but she likes to dance. On Tuesday and Thursday she goes to the gym near her house: there she does running for thirty minutes. Marie hates football and basketball, but she likes tennis: on Saturday she plays with her sister. In summer swimming is her sport, because the water is not cold. She does not play chess: it is a very slow game for her. On Sunday morning she paints and she draws in the garden: it is fun and it is not expensive. In the evening she watches a film with her sister. They love films, but they hate long films. Marie wants to travel to France for the music and for the parties.
